Manifest platform limitation: fanOut reactions run AFTER all mutations in a command and don't support != in where clauses. Attempted pattern: emit PaymentMethodDefaultSet → fanOut PaymentMethod where clientId = X run clearDefault. This clears ALL matching rows including the one being set as default, because: (1) mutate isDefault = true happens first, (2) emit triggers fanOut, (3) fanOut clears ALL rows (no != support), (4) no way to restore the target row after fanOut. Constraints also cannot check across rows (only self.*). This feature requires Manifest platform changes: either != support in fanOut where clauses, cross-row constraints, or a different native exclusivity mechanism. Escalated to backlog.
